decisions.reason: As a newly launched core-equipment product with no visible evidence yet of performance falling below aspiration levels, a medium-sized established machinery firm would likely keep it while learning from the market.
Because it is another newly introduced resin injection unit in the firm's core domain, management would probably retain it for at least another year unless early results clearly undercut aspirations.
The automatic airless spray gun fits the firm's established coating-equipment business, and with results still highly uncertain the firm is likely to use its slack to continue offering it.
As a manual variant close to the firm's existing capabilities, it would usually be kept while management gathers more evidence before judging it against aspiration levels.
This air-assisted airless spray gun appears to be a related line extension, so an experienced German machinery firm would typically keep it on the market during the early learning phase.

The data logger is somewhat more novel than the mechanical products, but as a complementary product for coating equipment it is still likely to be retained unless early feedback shows a clear shortfall.
